metaTitle: Custom Reflective Work Pants | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom reflective work pants with high-visibility stripes. Perfect for safety managers and bulk buyers at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Reflective work pants are essential for low-light job sites where visibility is critical. Unlike standard work pants, these feature high-visibility stripes on the legs, often made with 3M Scotchlite material, ensuring workers are seen from all angles. Ideal for construction crews, road maintenance teams, and warehouse staff who need both durability and safety compliance. Customize with your company logo using screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that meets OSHA guidelines.
heroAltText: Pair of custom reflective work pants with silver stripes on black fabric, designed for safety and visibility on job sites.
